main_measure.name: t of the slope of next-day excess return on forecast, bars with forecast > 0
main_measure.threshold: confirm: slope t >= 2 (with mean excess > 0 and >= 100 cases); reject: slope t <= -2 or mean excess t <= -2 (>= 100 cases)

supporting_check.name: mean next-day excess return on forecast > 0 bars above 0

decided_by: Fewer than 100 cases with forecast > 0: the plan's minimum count is not reached. (mean excess t = 0.179)
reading: Profile read from the recorded regime ('unknown' = no veto, i.e. falling agitated) since the detector's components are not recorded; the fall is a raw scaled return below 0 and the expected side long; the regression pools all coins' bars with forecast > 0, each coin's mean daily return taken over all its windows, and the cases are those bars with a next bar in the same window.
